afterImage.name: Ascension FBO Network
afterImage.description: Ascension FBO Network is an 11-location U.S. fixed-base operator platform that provides aircraft fueling, hangaring, ground handling and passenger and crew services for business and general aviation, with selected airline and military support. The platform was formed as Hawthorne Global Aviation Services in 2011 and adopted the Ascension commercial brand during 2025. NOVA Infrastructure and Wafra completed their joint acquisition on March 15, 2022 through Hawthorne FBO Acquisition Co.; exact economic percentages and Wafra's fund allocation are not publicly disclosed. Individual airport locations, leases and add-on businesses remain beneath the single manager-level platform.
